name: Asahanada Omi
source:
[i]"I am the One Shrouded in the Dark. Seal away my magic and allow me to show thou the End through this very card."[/i]

Asahanada is tall, does not talk much, and seems intimidating. However, he's actually just an oddball who loves using Chuni terms. He sees himself as an inhabitant of darkness and feels pain whenever he has to witness those "three party animal idiots" shining like light bombs in front of him. Asahanada is also a big fan of Kanto's mascot, "Kanto-kun," and loves collecting all kinds of Kanto-kun merchandise. He used to be part of the Public Safety Bureau at the KANSAI Police Department and is the only person to have transferred from the KANSAI area to the Special Investigation Department.

[From [url=https://velvet-react.com/en/chara010.php]Official Website[/url]]
